owner_and_capability: Legacy composition — contract step for the account routes (modules/identityaccess/inbound/auth, now modules/identityaccess/inbound/account as identity-access/http) and the operator router api/operator, with the Settings Platform public contract modules/settings (TenantReader, OperatorSchoolSettings) and its composition modules/settings/compose (#2736)
atomic_cutover: One PR removes every baseline entry and every policy rule that names #2736. The account routes move file for file from modules/identityaccess/inbound/auth to modules/identityaccess/inbound/account (identity-access/http), and the inbound-auth owner, its rule and the #3230 relocation record are deleted. Their remaining foreign imports become consumer-owned ports bound at the root (caregiver capability, role grants, tenant unit of work, demo switch, Settings Platform tenant reads). The operator school settings routes call the new public OperatorSchoolSettings capability of modules/settings, built by modules/settings/compose. The provisioning routes take the caregiver capability as a port and classify store failures through organizationtenancy.MarkIdentityStoreFailure. api/operator keeps only the router, with Identity & Access session chains, and Device Fleet maps its own resolution refusals. Routes, methods, status codes, error bodies and middleware chains are unchanged; the middleware golden only renames the package of the account routes.
